name: Acquired Palace recipient carrier state difference diagnosis

steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local F=assert(JAC_AbsorptionFlowGameplay)
local flow=assert(F.Get('native-acquired-palace-route'))
local tx=assert(A.GetState().Transactions[flow.ID])
local snap
for _,work in ipairs(tx.NativeWorks or {}) do if work.Source.Index==2 then snap=work end end
assert(snap and snap.Carrier and snap.Carrier.Phase=='RETURN' and not snap.PhysicalMoved,'diagnostic did not stop at carrier RETURN')
local current=A.NativeWorkLocations(2)
assert(#current==1 and current[1].Owner==1 and current[1].X==snap.Carrier.X and current[1].Y==snap.Carrier.Y and current[1].Building==snap.Carrier.Building and current[1].Slot==snap.Carrier.Slot,'original index lost during carrier diagnostic')
assert(tx.Error and tx.Error:find('carrier city changed during custody',1,true),'carrier difference was not reported')
print('[JAC_NATIVE_ACQUIRED_CARRIER_DIFF] '..tx.Error)
return 'original index remains one in recipient Temple; changed city field: '..tx.Error
